conbody.p: Safe Exit Warning may not operate normally, or Safe Exit Warning may operate unexpectedly under the following warning.

li.p: Getting out of the vehicle where trees or grass are overgrown
Getting out of the vehicle where the road is wet
When the rear corner radar is blocked by nearby objects such as vehicles, pillars, or walls
The approaching vehicle is very fast

note.p: For more details on the precautions of the rear corner radars, refer to Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist (BCA).

li.p: Safe Exit Warning may not operate normally if interfered by strong electromagnetic waves.
Safe Exit Warning may not operate for approximately 3 seconds after the vehicle is restarted, or the rear corner radars are initialized.
Even after starting the vehicle again, Safe Exit Warning not function properly when the obstruction or malfunction condition persists.
